power_aod_550.label: Haze from dust and smoke (aerosols)
power_aod_550.plain: How hazy the air is from dust, smoke and other particles. Higher = more haze; dry-season peaks come from Saharan dust and grass burning.
power_aod_550.method: Aerosol optical depth at 550 nm, CERES SYN1deg via NASA POWER; value of the ~110 km grid cell at the county centre.
power_aod_550.caution: Very coarse grid (~110 km): neighbouring counties often share one value.

power_aod_840.label: Haze from coarse dust (aerosols, 840 nm)
power_aod_840.plain: How hazy the air is, measured at a longer wavelength that responds more to coarse dust than to smoke. Higher = more haze.
power_aod_840.method: Aerosol optical depth at 840 nm, CERES SYN1deg via NASA POWER; county-centre grid cell (~110 km).
power_aod_840.caution: Very coarse grid (~110 km): neighbouring counties often share one value.

s5p_co.label: Carbon monoxide in the air (smoke)
s5p_co.plain: Amount of carbon monoxide in the air column, a gas released mostly by grass and bush fires in the dry season. Higher = more smoke.
s5p_co.method: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI total column, mean of quality-filtered pixels from 4 sampled orbits per month.
s5p_co.caution: Only a few satellite passes sampled per month; noisy and cloud-affected in the wet season.

s5p_no2.label: Nitrogen dioxide in the air (NO2)
s5p_no2.plain: Amount of nitrogen dioxide, a pollutant from burning (fires, engines, gas flaring). Mostly near zero except near towns, fires and oil fields.
s5p_no2.method: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI tropospheric NO2, mean of quality-filtered pixels from 4 sampled orbits per month.
s5p_no2.caution: Near the satellite's detection limit across most of the country; county values can be zero or negative.

s5p_aerosol_index.label: Dust and smoke index (UV aerosol index)
s5p_aerosol_index.plain: Detects light-absorbing particles such as desert dust and smoke. Positive values = dust or smoke present; values near or below zero = clean air or clouds.
s5p_aerosol_index.method: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI UV aerosol index, mean of quality-filtered pixels from 4 sampled orbits per month.
s5p_aerosol_index.how_to_read: Above 0 = dust or smoke present; can be negative.
s5p_aerosol_index.caution: Only a few satellite passes sampled per month; noisy.

tc_srad.label: Sunshine (incoming solar radiation)
tc_srad.plain: How much sunlight reaches the ground. Lower in the cloudy rainy season, higher in the dry season.

tc_vpd.label: Dryness of the air (vapour pressure deficit)
tc_vpd.plain: How 'thirsty' the air is: the gap between how much moisture the air holds and how much it could hold. High values dry out crops and pasture.
tc_vpd.how_to_read: Higher = drier, more stressful air for plants and livestock.

richness_amphibians.label: Amphibian species (frogs, toads)
richness_amphibians.plain: Average number of amphibian species whose known range covers this county. Higher = richer wildlife.
richness_amphibians.method: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013) from IUCN / BirdLife range maps; mean species per 10 km cell.
richness_amphibians.caution: Based on where species could live (range maps), not field sightings.

richness_birds.label: Bird species
richness_birds.plain: Average number of bird species whose known range covers this county. Higher = richer wildlife.
richness_birds.method: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013) from IUCN / BirdLife range maps; mean species per 10 km cell.
richness_birds.caution: Based on where species could live (range maps), not field sightings.

richness_mammals.label: Mammal species
richness_mammals.plain: Average number of mammal species whose known range covers this county. Higher = richer wildlife.
richness_mammals.method: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013) from IUCN / BirdLife range maps; mean species per 10 km cell.
richness_mammals.caution: Based on where species could live (range maps), not field sightings.

richness_threatened_birds.label: Threatened bird species
richness_threatened_birds.plain: Average number of threatened (IUCN red-list) bird species whose range covers this county.
richness_threatened_birds.method: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013) from IUCN / BirdLife range maps; mean species per 10 km cell.
richness_threatened_birds.caution: Based on where species could live (range maps), not field sightings.

richness_threatened_mammals.label: Threatened mammal species
richness_threatened_mammals.plain: Average number of threatened (IUCN red-list) mammal species whose range covers this county.
richness_threatened_mammals.method: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013) from IUCN / BirdLife range maps; mean species per 10 km cell.
richness_threatened_mammals.caution: Based on where species could live (range maps), not field sightings.

richness_vertebrates.label: Animal species (amphibians, birds, mammals)
richness_vertebrates.plain: Average number of amphibian, bird and mammal species whose known range covers this county. Reptiles are not included.
richness_vertebrates.method: BiodiversityMapping.org (Jenkins, Pimm & Joppa 2013) from IUCN / BirdLife range maps; mean species per 10 km cell.
richness_vertebrates.caution: Based on where species could live (range maps), not field sightings.

drought_ensemble_range.label: Drought uncertainty (range between sources)
drought_ensemble_range.plain: Gap between the wettest and driest of the four drought indices. Larger = less certain whether the county is dry or wet.
drought_ensemble_range.method: Maximum minus minimum across the four drought-ensemble members (SD units).

drought_ensemble_agree.label: Drought sources in agreement (share)
drought_ensemble_agree.plain: Share of the four drought indices that agree on whether the county is drier or wetter than normal. 1 = all agree.
drought_ensemble_agree.method: Share of ensemble members with the same sign as the ensemble mean (0-1).

drought_ensemble_mean.label: Drought index (combined, best estimate)
drought_ensemble_mean.plain: Our main drought measure: the average of four drought indices built from different rain data. Below zero = drier than normal for the season, above zero = wetter.
drought_ensemble_mean.method: Ensemble of IMERG SPEI-3, CHIRPS SPI-3, TerraClimate SPEI-3 and re-standardised TerraClimate PDSI. At least 3 members required; values in standard deviations.
drought_ensemble_mean.how_to_read: Below -1 = moderate drought, below -1.5 = severe; above +1 = unusually wet
drought_ensemble_mean.caution: Leans slightly dry because the TerraClimate members are dry-biased. Trust a drought only when members agree and spread is low.

drought_ensemble_spread.label: Drought uncertainty (how much sources disagree)
drought_ensemble_spread.plain: How much the four drought indices disagree for this county and month. Low = the rain datasets agree; high = the answer depends on which dataset you trust.
drought_ensemble_spread.method: Standard deviation across the four drought-ensemble members.
drought_ensemble_spread.how_to_read: Below 0.5 = sources agree; above 1 = sources disagree strongly (common in the Sudd and Upper Nile)

dr_pdsi_tc_z.label: Long-term drought (Palmer index, adjusted)
dr_pdsi_tc_z.plain: A slow-moving drought index that reflects the past 9-12 months of rain and heat, rescaled so 0 = normal for that county and month.
dr_pdsi_tc_z.method: TerraClimate PDSI z-scored per county and calendar month vs 1991-2020. Drought-ensemble member.
dr_pdsi_tc_z.how_to_read: Below -1 = unusually dry, above +1 = unusually wet
dr_pdsi_tc_z.caution: Uses TerraClimate rain, which is dry-biased after 2018; shares that input with the TerraClimate SPEI.

tc_pdsi.label: Palmer drought index (raw)
tc_pdsi.plain: A classic long-term drought index. Negative = drought, positive = wet. In this dataset values sit far below zero every year, even in flood years.
tc_pdsi.method: TerraClimate v1.1 Palmer Drought Severity Index (scale about -4 dry to +4 wet).
tc_pdsi.caution: Reads about -5 to -8 every year, including the 2020 flood year: a dry bias in the input rain. Use the combined drought index instead.

dr_spei3_tc.label: 3-month drought index (TerraClimate)
dr_spei3_tc.plain: Compares the last three months of rain minus evaporation with normal for that county and season. Below zero = drier than normal.
dr_spei3_tc.method: SPEI-3 from TerraClimate precipitation minus Penman-Monteith PET, log-logistic fit, 1991-2020 baseline.
dr_spei3_tc.how_to_read: Below -1 = unusually dry, above +1 = unusually wet
dr_spei3_tc.caution: TerraClimate rain is ~40% below other products after 2018, so this index leans toward drought.

spei3.label: 3-month drought index (SPEI, satellite rain)
spei3.plain: Compares the last three months of rain minus evaporation with what is normal for that county and season. Below zero = drier than normal.
spei3.method: SPEI-3 from IMERG precipitation minus Thornthwaite PET (MERRA-2 temperature), county series 2000-2026.
spei3.how_to_read: Below -1 = unusually dry, above +1 = unusually wet
spei3.caution: Short baseline and a simple evaporation formula; best read alongside the combined drought index.

dr_spi3_chirps.label: 3-month rainfall index (CHIRPS)
dr_spi3_chirps.plain: Compares the last three months of rain with what is normal for that county and season. Below zero = less rain than usual.
dr_spi3_chirps.method: SPI-3 from CHIRPS v3.0, gamma fit with zero-rain probability, 1991-2020 baseline, capped at +/-3.09.
dr_spi3_chirps.how_to_read: Below -1 = unusually dry, above +1 = unusually wet
dr_spi3_chirps.caution: Unstable in dry-season months when almost no rain falls.

tc_extreme_dry.label: Unusually dry month (flag)
tc_extreme_dry.plain: Marks months when rainfall was in the driest 10% for that county and month of the year, compared with 1991-2020. Never set in normally rainless months.
tc_extreme_dry.method: TerraClimate precipitation below the county's 1991-2020 10th percentile for that calendar month.
tc_extreme_dry.caution: Fires far too often (~30% of months) because TerraClimate rain is dry-biased after 2018.

tc_extreme_heat.label: Unusually hot month (flag)
tc_extreme_heat.plain: Marks months when daytime highs were in the hottest 10% for that county and month of the year, compared with 1991-2020.
tc_extreme_heat.method: TerraClimate monthly mean daily max temperature above the county's 1991-2020 90th percentile for that calendar month.
tc_extreme_heat.caution: TerraClimate's recent years run hotter and drier than its own 1991-2020 baseline, so this flag fires in ~30% of months.

tc_extreme_wet.label: Unusually wet month (flag)
tc_extreme_wet.plain: Marks months when rainfall was in the wettest 10% for that county and month of the year, compared with 1991-2020.
tc_extreme_wet.method: TerraClimate precipitation above the county's 1991-2020 90th percentile for that calendar month.
tc_extreme_wet.caution: Fires rarely (~4% of months) because TerraClimate rain is dry-biased after 2018.

tc_extreme_count.label: Number of extreme-weather flags
tc_extreme_count.plain: How many of three extremes (very wet, very dry, very hot) happened in the county that month, from 0 to 3.
tc_extreme_count.method: Sum of the TerraClimate extreme wet, dry and heat flags vs 1991-2020 county percentiles.
tc_extreme_count.how_to_read: 0 = no extremes, 3 = wet, dry and hot extremes at once (rare)
tc_extreme_count.caution: Dry and heat flags fire too often because TerraClimate leans dry and hot after 2018.

fire_count.label: Active fires detected (MODIS)
fire_count.plain: Number of fire detections seen by NASA's MODIS satellites in the month. Fires are mostly grass and bush burning in the dry season (Nov-Mar).
fire_count.method: MODIS MOD14A1/MYD14A1 daily 1 km fire mask, Terra + Aqua; months with partial coverage scaled up, <50% coverage dropped.
fire_count.caution: Jul-Nov 2025 missing. Prefer the VIIRS fire count, which sees smaller fires.

burned_area_km2.label: Burned area
burned_area_km2.plain: Area of land that burned during the month, in square kilometres. Mostly dry-season grass fires; usually zero in the rainy months.
burned_area_km2.method: MODIS MCD64A1 v061 monthly burned area.
burned_area_km2.caution: Some months are missing from the data source (e.g. 2023-09, 2024-07, 2025-05, 2025-08 to 2025-10).

burned_area_pct.label: Burned area (% of county)
burned_area_pct.plain: Share of the county's land that burned during the month. Mostly dry-season grass fires; usually zero in the rainy months.
burned_area_pct.method: MODIS MCD64A1 v061 monthly burned area divided by county area.
burned_area_pct.caution: Some months are missing from the data source (e.g. 2023-09, 2024-07, 2025-05, 2025-08 to 2025-10).

viirs_noaa20_fire_count.label: Active fires detected (VIIRS, NOAA-20)
viirs_noaa20_fire_count.plain: Number of fire detections from the NOAA-20 satellite, which sees fires as small as a few hundred metres. Available from 2020 only.
viirs_noaa20_fire_count.method: NASA FIRMS VIIRS NOAA-20 375 m, standard processing. Nearly identical to the S-NPP series (r = 0.998).
viirs_noaa20_fire_count.caution: Starts in 2020; use the S-NPP VIIRS series for 2018-2025 trends.

viirs_fire_count.label: Active fires detected (VIIRS)
viirs_fire_count.plain: Number of fire detections in the month from the VIIRS satellite sensor, which sees small fires well. Fires peak in the dry season (Nov-Mar).
viirs_fire_count.method: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP 375 m, one sensor for 2018-2025. Detects ~1.45x as many fires as MODIS (r = 0.98).

viirs_noaa20_frp_sum.label: Fire intensity (VIIRS, NOAA-20)
viirs_noaa20_frp_sum.plain: Total heat given off by fires detected in the month, a rough measure of how big and intense the fires were. Available from 2020 only.
viirs_noaa20_frp_sum.method: Sum of fire radiative power (MW) of NOAA-20 VIIRS 375 m detections at overpass time.

viirs_frp_sum.label: Fire intensity (VIIRS)
viirs_frp_sum.plain: Total heat given off by fires detected in the month, a rough measure of how much and how intensely land burned.
viirs_frp_sum.method: Sum of instantaneous fire radiative power (MW) of S-NPP VIIRS 375 m detections at overpass time.

lulc_bare_pct.label: Bare ground (% of county)
lulc_bare_pct.plain: Share of the county that is bare soil, rock or sand with little or no plant cover, from yearly satellite land maps.
lulc_bare_pct.method: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m annual land cover from Sentinel-2 (2017-2023); share of county pixels.
lulc_bare_pct.caution: Annual, 2017-2023 only. Some year-to-year change comes from classifier differences, not real change.

lulc_built_pct.label: Built-up area (% of county)
lulc_built_pct.plain: Share of the county covered by buildings, roads and other built structures, from yearly satellite land maps.
lulc_built_pct.method: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m annual land cover from Sentinel-2 (2017-2023); share of county pixels.
lulc_built_pct.caution: Annual, 2017-2023 only. Some year-to-year change comes from classifier differences, not real change.

lulc_crop_pct.label: Cropland (% of county)
lulc_crop_pct.plain: Share of the county used for growing crops, from yearly satellite land maps.
lulc_crop_pct.method: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m annual land cover from Sentinel-2 (2017-2023); share of county pixels.
lulc_crop_pct.caution: Annual, 2017-2023 only. Some year-to-year change comes from classifier differences, not real change.

lulc_flooded_veg_pct.label: Flooded vegetation / swamp (% of county)
lulc_flooded_veg_pct.plain: Share of the county that is swamp or grassland standing in water, from yearly satellite land maps. Grew during the 2019-2022 floods.
lulc_flooded_veg_pct.method: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m annual land cover from Sentinel-2 (2017-2023); share of county pixels.
lulc_flooded_veg_pct.caution: Annual, 2017-2023 only. Some year-to-year change comes from classifier differences, not real change.

lulc_rangeland_pct.label: Grassland and shrubland (% of county)
lulc_rangeland_pct.plain: Share of the county covered by grass and shrubs (grazing land), from yearly satellite land maps.
lulc_rangeland_pct.method: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m annual land cover from Sentinel-2 (2017-2023); share of county pixels.
lulc_rangeland_pct.caution: Annual, 2017-2023 only. Some year-to-year change comes from classifier differences, not real change.

lulc_trees_pct.label: Tree cover (% of county)
lulc_trees_pct.plain: Share of the county covered by trees and forest, from yearly satellite land maps.
lulc_trees_pct.method: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m annual land cover from Sentinel-2 (2017-2023); share of county pixels.
lulc_trees_pct.caution: Annual, 2017-2023 only. Some year-to-year change comes from classifier differences, not real change.

lulc_water_pct.label: Water (% of county, land-cover map)
lulc_water_pct.plain: Share of the county that is open water in the yearly satellite land map. Rose during the 2019-2022 floods.
lulc_water_pct.method: Esri / Impact Observatory 10 m annual land cover from Sentinel-2 (2017-2023); share of county pixels.
lulc_water_pct.caution: Annual, 2017-2023 only. Some year-to-year change comes from classifier differences, not real change.

modis_refl_nir.label: Satellite brightness: near-infrared
modis_refl_nir.plain: Raw satellite measurement of how much invisible near-infrared light the land reflects. Healthy plants reflect a lot. Mainly for specialists.
modis_refl_nir.method: MODIS MOD09A1 v061 band 2 (841-876 nm) surface reflectance, cloud-screened.

modis_refl_red.label: Satellite brightness: red light
modis_refl_red.plain: Raw satellite measurement of how much red light the land reflects. Green plants absorb red light, so lower often means more vegetation. Mainly for specialists.
modis_refl_red.method: MODIS MOD09A1 v061 band 1 (620-670 nm) surface reflectance, cloud-screened.

modis_refl_swir1.label: Satellite brightness: shortwave infrared
modis_refl_swir1.plain: Raw satellite measurement of shortwave-infrared light reflected by the land, sensitive to moisture and burn scars. Mainly for specialists.
modis_refl_swir1.method: MODIS MOD09A1 v061 band 6 (1628-1652 nm) surface reflectance, cloud-screened.

precip_mm.label: Rainfall (NASA IMERG satellite)
precip_mm.plain: Total rain in the month, in millimetres, estimated by NASA's GPM satellite constellation.
precip_mm.method: GPM IMERG V07 Final via NASA POWER, mm/day converted to mm/month. Independent of CHIRPS; used in the SPEI.
precip_mm.caution: Rain products disagree in South Sudan (very few rain gauges); never trust a rainfall trend seen in only one product.

power_precip_mm.label: Rainfall (MERRA-2 model)
power_precip_mm.plain: Total rain in the month, in millimetres, from a weather model adjusted toward satellite observations.
power_precip_mm.method: MERRA-2 PRECTOTCORR (bias-corrected) via NASA POWER, mm/day x days in month.
power_precip_mm.caution: Model rain is smooth and coarse; prefer CHIRPS or IMERG.

tc_ppt.label: Rainfall (TerraClimate)
tc_ppt.plain: Total rain in the month, in millimetres, at fine (~4 km) detail.
tc_ppt.method: TerraClimate v1.1 precipitation (WorldClim normals + CRU/JRA-55/ERA5 anomalies).
tc_ppt.caution: About 40% lower than IMERG in 2018-2025; use for spatial patterns, not totals or trends.

chirps_precip_mm.label: Rainfall (CHIRPS)
chirps_precip_mm.plain: Total rain in the month, in millimetres, from satellite images blended with rain-gauge data. The default rainfall layer.
chirps_precip_mm.method: CHIRPS v3.0 (UCSB Climate Hazards Center): infrared cold-cloud duration + climatology + station blend.
chirps_precip_mm.caution: Few gauges in South Sudan; 30-48% below IMERG in Sudd counties, and its trend differs from IMERG. Compare products.

soil_wrb_dominant.label: Main soil type
soil_wrb_dominant.plain: The most common soil type in the county, as a category code (for example 29 = Vertisols, cracking clay soils that flood easily).
soil_wrb_dominant.method: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 dominant WRB reference soil group (codes 0-29).
soil_wrb_dominant.how_to_read: A category code, not an amount: 11 = Fluvisols, 12 = Gleysols, 29 = Vertisols

soil_clay_0_30cm.label: Clay in topsoil
soil_clay_0_30cm.plain: Percentage of clay in the top 30 cm of soil. High-clay 'black cotton' soils hold water and flood easily.
soil_clay_0_30cm.method: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, clay mass fraction 0-30 cm.

soil_soc_0_30cm.label: Organic carbon in topsoil
soil_soc_0_30cm.plain: Amount of organic matter (carbon) in the top 30 cm of soil, in grams per kilogram. Higher usually means more fertile soil.
soil_soc_0_30cm.method: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, soil organic carbon 0-30 cm (g/kg).

soil_phh2o_0_30cm.label: Topsoil acidity (pH)
soil_phh2o_0_30cm.plain: How acidic or alkaline the top 30 cm of soil is. 7 = neutral, below 7 = acidic, above 7 = alkaline.
soil_phh2o_0_30cm.method: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, pH in water 0-30 cm.

soil_sand_0_30cm.label: Sand in topsoil
soil_sand_0_30cm.plain: Percentage of sand in the top 30 cm of soil. Sandy soils drain fast and hold little water.
soil_sand_0_30cm.method: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, sand mass fraction 0-30 cm.

soil_vertisol_pct.label: Cracking clay soils (% of county)
soil_vertisol_pct.plain: Share of the county with Vertisols: heavy clay soils that crack when dry and flood in the rains. Fertile but hard to farm.
soil_vertisol_pct.method: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, share of county with Vertisols as dominant group.

soilwet_root.label: Root-zone soil wetness
soilwet_root.plain: How wet the soil is in the top metre where crop and grass roots grow, from 0 (dry) to 1 (saturated).
soilwet_root.method: MERRA-2 GWETROOT (Catchment land model) via NASA POWER (~50 km).
soilwet_root.caution: Driven by model rain; does not know about river or swamp flooding.

tc_soil.label: Soil moisture (TerraClimate)
tc_soil.plain: Water available to plants in the soil at the end of the month, in millimetres.
tc_soil.method: TerraClimate one-layer water-balance model, plant-extractable soil water.
tc_soil.caution: TerraClimate runs about 40% drier than other rain products in 2018-2025, so it leans toward drought. Use it for patterns, not totals.

tmax_c.label: Daytime high temperature
tmax_c.plain: Average daily maximum air temperature in the month, in degrees Celsius.
tmax_c.method: MERRA-2 reanalysis 2 m T2M_MAX_AVG via NASA POWER (~50 km). Recommended for temperature trends.

tmin_c.label: Night-time low temperature
tmin_c.plain: Average daily minimum air temperature in the month, in degrees Celsius.
tmin_c.method: MERRA-2 reanalysis 2 m T2M_MIN_AVG via NASA POWER (~50 km).

power_t2m_max.label: Hottest hour of the month
power_t2m_max.plain: The single highest hourly air temperature recorded in the month, in degrees Celsius.
power_t2m_max.method: MERRA-2 T2M_MAX via NASA POWER (~50 km).

modis_lst_day_c.label: Daytime ground surface temperature
modis_lst_day_c.plain: How hot the ground surface gets mid-morning, measured by satellite. Usually hotter than air temperature.
modis_lst_day_c.method: MODIS MOD11A2 v061 land surface temperature, Terra ~10:30 local, quality-filtered.
modis_lst_day_c.caution: Seen only on cloud-free days, so rainy-season months are biased toward dry, hot days.

modis_lst_night_c.label: Night-time ground surface temperature
modis_lst_night_c.plain: How warm the ground surface stays at night, measured by satellite.
modis_lst_night_c.method: MODIS MOD11A2 v061 land surface temperature, Terra ~22:30 local, quality-filtered.
modis_lst_night_c.caution: Seen only on cloud-free nights, so rainy-season months are under-sampled.

tc_tmax.label: Daytime high temperature (TerraClimate)
tc_tmax.plain: Average daily maximum temperature in the month at finer (~4 km) detail, in degrees Celsius.
tc_tmax.method: TerraClimate v1.1 monthly mean of daily maximum temperature (~4 km).
tc_tmax.caution: Use for spatial detail; the MERRA-2 series is preferred for trends.

tair_c.label: Average air temperature
tair_c.plain: Average air temperature over day and night for the month, in degrees Celsius.
tair_c.method: MERRA-2 reanalysis 2 m T2M via NASA POWER (~50 km).

tc_tmin.label: Night-time low temperature (TerraClimate)
tc_tmin.plain: Average daily minimum temperature in the month at finer (~4 km) detail, in degrees Celsius.
tc_tmin.method: TerraClimate v1.1 monthly mean of daily minimum temperature (~4 km).

elevation_mean.label: Average elevation
elevation_mean.plain: Average height of the land above sea level, in metres. Low flat areas (the Sudd) flood more easily than highlands.

elevation_std.label: Hilliness (terrain ruggedness)
elevation_std.plain: How much the land height varies within the county, in metres. Low = flat plains; high = hills or mountains.
elevation_std.method: Copernicus DEM GLO-90, standard deviation of elevation within county.

modis_evi.label: Vegetation greenness (EVI)
modis_evi.plain: How green and leafy plants are, measured by NASA's MODIS satellites. Higher = greener; similar to NDVI but better in dense vegetation.
modis_evi.method: MODIS MOD13A1 + MYD13A1 v061 Enhanced Vegetation Index, cloud-masked, 500 m.
modis_evi.caution: Flooding lowers greenness, so a drop in the Sudd can mean flood rather than drought.

modis13a3_evi.label: Vegetation greenness (EVI, 1 km monthly)
modis13a3_evi.plain: How green and leafy plants are, from a monthly NASA MODIS product. Higher = greener. Fills Aug-Oct 2025 missing from the main greenness layer.
modis13a3_evi.method: MODIS MOD13A3 v061 monthly 1 km EVI via AppEEARS; r = 0.99 vs 500 m EVI, about 0.03 lower.
modis13a3_evi.caution: Flooding lowers greenness, so a drop in the Sudd can mean flood rather than drought.

modis_ndvi.label: Vegetation greenness (NDVI)
modis_ndvi.plain: How green plants are, measured by NASA's MODIS satellites. Higher = greener crops, grass and trees; lower = bare, dry or flooded land.
modis_ndvi.method: MODIS MOD13A1 + MYD13A1 v061 NDVI, cloud-masked, monthly maximum at 500 m.
modis_ndvi.how_to_read: About 0.1-0.2 = bare or dry; 0.6+ = dense green vegetation
modis_ndvi.caution: Flooding lowers greenness, so a drop in the Sudd can mean flood rather than drought. Aug-Oct 2025 missing.

modis13a3_ndvi.label: Vegetation greenness (NDVI, 1 km monthly)
modis13a3_ndvi.plain: How green plants are, from a monthly NASA MODIS product. Higher = greener. Fills Aug-Oct 2025 missing from the main greenness layer.
modis13a3_ndvi.method: MODIS MOD13A3 v061 monthly 1 km NDVI (weighted average of 16-day composites) via AppEEARS; r = 0.99, ~0.03 lower.
modis13a3_ndvi.how_to_read: About 0.1-0.2 = bare or dry; 0.6+ = dense green vegetation
modis13a3_ndvi.caution: Flooding lowers greenness, so a drop in the Sudd can mean flood rather than drought.

modis_et_mm.label: Water evaporated by land and plants (yearly)
modis_et_mm.plain: Total water that evaporated from soil and plants over the year, in millimetres. Higher = wetter, greener land using more water.
modis_et_mm.method: MODIS MOD16A3GF v061 annual gap-filled evapotranspiration (500 m).
modis_et_mm.caution: Open water, towns and bare land are excluded, so swamp counties such as the Sudd are under-represented.

modis_et_monthly_mm.label: Water evaporated by land and plants (monthly)
modis_et_monthly_mm.plain: Water that evaporated from soil and plants in the month, in millimetres.
modis_et_monthly_mm.method: MODIS MOD16A2GF v061 8-day gap-filled ET (Penman-Monteith), summed to months via AppEEARS.
modis_et_monthly_mm.caution: Open water, towns and bare land are excluded, so swamp counties such as the Sudd are under-represented.

sudd_climfill_pct.label: Sudd water map: share estimated from typical years
sudd_climfill_pct.plain: Data-quality check for the Sudd water layer: share of the county that was cloudy too long and was filled with the usual value for that time of year.
sudd_climfill_pct.method: Share of pixels cloudy >24 days, filled with their 2018-2025 inundation probability for that composite of the year.
sudd_climfill_pct.how_to_read: High = the month's value leans toward the long-term average

surface_water_obs_pct.label: Surface-water map: cloud-free coverage
surface_water_obs_pct.plain: Data-quality check for the surface-water layer: share of the county the satellite could see through clouds that month. Low in the rainy season (Jun-Oct).
surface_water_obs_pct.method: Share of county area with cloud-free MODIS 8-day observations in the month.
surface_water_obs_pct.how_to_read: Low = surface-water value is less reliable that month

sudd_clear_pct.label: Sudd water map: directly observed share
sudd_clear_pct.plain: Data-quality check for the Sudd water layer: share of the value seen directly by the satellite rather than filled in. Low from June to October.
sudd_clear_pct.method: Share of the county's monthly value from QA-clear MODIS observations (rest carried forward or climatology).
sudd_clear_pct.how_to_read: Low = more of the value is estimated

flood_s1_flood_pct.label: Flooded area (% of county, radar)
flood_s1_flood_pct.plain: Share of the county newly under water compared with its normal dry-season state, mapped by radar satellite that sees through cloud and under grass.
flood_s1_flood_pct.method: Sentinel-1 C-band radar change detection: monthly VV-VH more than 3 dB above the pixel's March reference (~440 m grid).
flood_s1_flood_pct.how_to_read: Near 0 in the dry season; peaks Sep-Oct
flood_s1_flood_pct.caution: Radar flood map is reliable Jul-Nov; it misses flooded vegetation and receding water in the dry season and disagrees with MODIS in Bor South. Use MODIS water / Sudd layer for all-season.

flood_s1_flood_km2.label: Flooded area (radar)
flood_s1_flood_km2.plain: Area newly under water compared with the normal dry-season state, in square kilometres, mapped by radar satellite that sees through cloud and under grass.
flood_s1_flood_km2.method: Sentinel-1 C-band radar change detection: monthly VV-VH more than 3 dB above the pixel's March reference (~440 m grid).
flood_s1_flood_km2.how_to_read: Near 0 in the dry season; peaks Sep-Oct
flood_s1_flood_km2.caution: Radar flood map is reliable Jul-Nov; it misses flooded vegetation and receding water in the dry season and disagrees with MODIS in Bor South. Use MODIS water / Sudd layer for all-season.

flood_oilfield_exposure_km2.label: Flooded land near oil wells and fields
flood_oilfield_exposure_km2.plain: Area of flood water within 5 km of mapped oil wells and fields, in square kilometres. A warning sign for possible spread of oil pollution, not a measure of it.
flood_oilfield_exposure_km2.method: Sentinel-1 flood class within 5 km of OSM wells and GEM GOGET oil fields (Unity, Ruweng, Upper Nile).
flood_oilfield_exposure_km2.caution: Exposure only: no open water-quality data exist. Radar flood map misses dry-season water.

flood_oil_wells_flooded.label: Oil wells/fields reached by flood water
flood_oil_wells_flooded.plain: Number of mapped oil wells or fields with flood water within 1 km. A warning sign for possible oil pollution spread, not a measure of it.
flood_oil_wells_flooded.method: Count of OSM wells / GEM GOGET fields within 1 km of Sentinel-1 flood pixels.
flood_oil_wells_flooded.caution: Exposure only, not measured contamination. Well mapping is incomplete (mostly Rubkona/Guit).

flood_s1_openwater_km2.label: Open water (radar)
flood_s1_openwater_km2.plain: Area of open, calm water (rivers, lakes, open flood water) in square kilometres, mapped by radar satellite.
flood_s1_openwater_km2.method: Sentinel-1 pixels with VV < -18 dB and VH < -24 dB (dark, mirror-like water).
flood_s1_openwater_km2.caution: Jumps about 10x in 2025 from satellite and processing changes: not safe for trends. Wind-roughened water is missed.

flood_population_exposed.label: People living in flooded areas
flood_population_exposed.plain: Estimated number of people whose homes are in places the radar map shows as flooded. Floods mix with latrine waste, so this signals exposure to contaminated water.
flood_population_exposed.method: Sentinel-1 flood class x WorldPop R2025A 1 km population (year-matched).
flood_population_exposed.caution: Exposure, not illness. Misses displaced people and dyke-protected towns (Bentiu, Rubkona); radar misses dry-season water.

flood_s1_obs_pct.label: Radar flood map: coverage in month
flood_s1_obs_pct.plain: Data-quality check for the radar flood layer: share of the county covered by satellite passes that month. Drops after one of the two satellites failed in Dec 2021.
flood_s1_obs_pct.method: Share of county area with a Sentinel-1 acquisition (or carried value) in the month.
flood_s1_obs_pct.how_to_read: Low = radar flood value is less reliable

flood_population_exposed_pct.label: Share of people living in flooded areas
flood_population_exposed_pct.plain: Percentage of the county's population whose homes are in places the radar map shows as flooded.
flood_population_exposed_pct.method: Sentinel-1 flood class x WorldPop R2025A 1 km population, divided by county population.
flood_population_exposed_pct.caution: Exposure, not illness. Misses displaced people and dyke-protected towns; radar misses dry-season water.

sudd_inundation_pct.label: Sudd flooded area incl. swamp (% of county)
sudd_inundation_pct.plain: Share of the county under water, including water hidden under swamp grass and papyrus. Covers the 16 Sudd wetland counties only.
sudd_inundation_pct.method: MODIS MOD09A1 8-day 500 m: open water (MNDWI > 0) or flooded vegetation (EVI-LSWI <= 0.05); cloud gaps filled.
sudd_inundation_pct.caution: Sudd counties only. Jul-Nov 2025 missing. Dense papyrus is missed in the dry season.

sudd_inundation_km2.label: Sudd flooded area incl. swamp
sudd_inundation_km2.plain: Area under water, including water hidden under swamp grass and papyrus, in square kilometres. Our most consistent all-season flood record for the 16 Sudd counties.
sudd_inundation_km2.method: MODIS MOD09A1 8-day 500 m: open water (MNDWI > 0) or flooded vegetation (EVI-LSWI <= 0.05); validated vs UNOSAT (ratio 0.99).
sudd_inundation_km2.caution: Sudd counties only. Jul-Nov 2025 missing (no satellite data). Dense papyrus is missed in the dry season.

sudd_openwater_km2.label: Sudd open water (no vegetation)
sudd_openwater_km2.plain: Area of open water with no plants on top (rivers, lakes, flood lakes) in square kilometres, in the 16 Sudd counties.
sudd_openwater_km2.method: MODIS MOD09A1 8-day 500 m pixels with MNDWI > 0.
sudd_openwater_km2.caution: Small and zero in some counties; most Sudd water stands under vegetation, so see the Sudd flooded-area layer.

surface_water_pct.label: Surface water (% of county)
surface_water_pct.plain: Share of the county covered by visible water (rivers, lakes, open flood water) in the month, seen by NASA's MODIS satellites. Works in all seasons.
surface_water_pct.method: MODIS Terra+Aqua 8-day: MNDWI(B4,B7) > 0.1 in at least half of cloud-free composites; cloud gaps carried up to 2 months.
surface_water_pct.caution: Misses water under vegetation and is blocked by rainy-season cloud; totals are about half of UNOSAT maps. Read as a relative signal.

surface_water_km2.label: Surface water area
surface_water_km2.plain: Area covered by visible water (rivers, lakes, open flood water) in square kilometres, seen by NASA's MODIS satellites. Works in all seasons.
surface_water_km2.method: MODIS Terra+Aqua 8-day: MNDWI(B4,B7) > 0.1 in at least half of cloud-free composites; cloud gaps carried up to 2 months.
surface_water_km2.caution: Misses water under vegetation and is blocked by rainy-season cloud; totals are about half of UNOSAT maps. Read as a relative signal.

tc_aet.label: Water used by plants and soil (TerraClimate)
tc_aet.plain: Water that actually evaporated from soil and plants in the month, in millimetres. Tracks how much water vegetation is using.
tc_aet.caution: TerraClimate runs about 40% drier than other rain products in 2018-2025, so it leans toward drought. Use it for patterns, not totals.

tc_def.label: Water shortfall for plants (climatic water deficit)
tc_def.plain: How much more water plants and soil could have used than was available in the month, in millimetres. Higher = drier conditions.
tc_def.caution: Overstated because TerraClimate rain is dry-biased after 2018.

pet_mm.label: Evaporation demand (simple estimate)
pet_mm.plain: How much water the air could evaporate from wet ground and plants in the month, based on temperature only. Higher = thirstier conditions.
pet_mm.method: Thornthwaite potential evapotranspiration from MERRA-2 monthly mean temperature.
pet_mm.caution: This simple formula underestimates evaporation in hot, dry climates; prefer the Penman-Monteith version for size.

tc_pet.label: Evaporation demand (TerraClimate)
tc_pet.plain: How much water the air could evaporate from wet ground and plants in the month, given heat, sun, wind and humidity. Higher = thirstier conditions.

tc_q.label: Runoff (TerraClimate)
tc_q.plain: Rain water that runs off the land into streams in the month, in millimetres. Often zero in the dry season.
tc_q.caution: Understated because TerraClimate rain is dry-biased after 2018.

g3p_gwsa_unc_cm.label: Groundwater estimate: uncertainty
g3p_gwsa_unc_cm.plain: How uncertain the satellite groundwater estimate is, in centimetres of water. Larger = less confident.
g3p_gwsa_unc_cm.method: G3P v1.12 one-standard-deviation uncertainty of the groundwater storage anomaly.

g3p_gwsa_cm.label: Groundwater change (satellite gravity)
g3p_gwsa_cm.plain: Whether underground water is above or below its 2002-2020 average, in centimetres of water, estimated from satellites that weigh water by its gravity.
g3p_gwsa_cm.method: G3P v1.12: GRACE total water storage minus modelled soil moisture and surface water, vs 2002-2020 mean.
g3p_gwsa_cm.how_to_read: Above 0 = more groundwater than average; below 0 = less
g3p_gwsa_cm.caution: Ends Sep 2023. Very coarse (~300 km); in the Sudd, flood-water errors can leak in. Treat as indicative.

grace_tws_cm.label: Total water stored in the land (satellite gravity)
grace_tws_cm.plain: All water on and under the ground (floods, soil, groundwater) compared with the 2002-2020 average, in centimetres, from satellites that weigh water by its gravity.
grace_tws_cm.method: GFZ GravIS COST-G combined GRACE/GRACE-FO Level-3 terrestrial water storage anomaly.
grace_tws_cm.how_to_read: Above 0 = wetter than average; below 0 = drier
grace_tws_cm.caution: About 300 km resolution: read regionally, not county by county. No data Jan-May 2018. Sudd highs mostly reflect flood water.

grace_tws_unc_cm.label: Water storage estimate: uncertainty
grace_tws_unc_cm.plain: How uncertain the satellite water-storage estimate is, in centimetres of water. Larger = less confident.

power_ws10m_max.label: Strongest wind of the month
power_ws10m_max.plain: Highest hourly wind speed at 10 m height during the month, in metres per second. A rough signal of storms and dust-raising winds.
power_ws10m_max.method: MERRA-2 WS10M_MAX via NASA POWER (~50 km).

tc_ws.label: Wind speed (TerraClimate)
tc_ws.plain: Average wind speed at 10 m height in the month, in metres per second.
tc_ws.method: TerraClimate v1.1 wind speed at 10 m.

power_ws10m.label: Wind speed at 10 m
power_ws10m.plain: Average wind speed at 10 m height in the month, in metres per second.
power_ws10m.method: MERRA-2 WS10M via NASA POWER (~50 km).

power_ws2m.label: Wind speed near the ground (2 m)
power_ws2m.plain: Average wind speed at 2 m height (about head height) in the month, in metres per second.
power_ws2m.method: MERRA-2 WS2M via NASA POWER (~50 km).

fts_hum_funding_month_usd.label: Humanitarian funding received, monthly (national)
fts_hum_funding_month_usd.plain: US dollars of humanitarian aid recorded for South Sudan in the month, by the date the funding was decided.
fts_hum_funding_month_usd.method: OCHA Financial Tracking Service (FTS), incoming flows to South Sudan, paid/committed, de-duplicated.
fts_hum_funding_month_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

fts_hum_funding_year_usd.label: Humanitarian funding received, yearly (national)
fts_hum_funding_year_usd.plain: Total US dollars of humanitarian aid recorded for South Sudan in the calendar year (the same yearly figure is shown in every month).
fts_hum_funding_year_usd.method: OCHA FTS API, calendar-year total repeated each month.
fts_hum_funding_year_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

fts_us_gov_funding_month_usd.label: US government humanitarian funding, monthly (national)
fts_us_gov_funding_month_usd.plain: US dollars of humanitarian aid from the US government recorded for South Sudan in the month.
fts_us_gov_funding_month_usd.method: OCHA Financial Tracking Service (FTS), incoming flows to South Sudan, paid/committed, de-duplicated. US government donors only.
fts_us_gov_funding_month_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

fts_us_gov_funding_year_usd.label: US government humanitarian funding, yearly (national)
fts_us_gov_funding_year_usd.plain: Total US dollars of humanitarian aid from the US government for South Sudan in the calendar year (repeated each month).
fts_us_gov_funding_year_usd.method: OCHA FTS API, calendar-year total repeated each month.
fts_us_gov_funding_year_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

fts_us_share_year.label: US share of humanitarian funding (national)
fts_us_share_year.plain: The share of all humanitarian funding for South Sudan in the year that came from the US government.
fts_us_share_year.method: OCHA FTS API, US government / total, calendar year.
fts_us_share_year.how_to_read: 0 to 1: 0.5 = half of all funding came from the US
fts_us_share_year.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

hrp_coverage_year.label: Aid appeal funded (share, national)
hrp_coverage_year.plain: How much of the UN-led humanitarian appeal for South Sudan was funded in the year: money received divided by money requested.
hrp_coverage_year.method: OCHA FTS: Humanitarian Response Plan funding / requirement, calendar year.
hrp_coverage_year.how_to_read: 0 to 1: 0.6 = 60% of the appeal was funded
hrp_coverage_year.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

hrp_funding_year_usd.label: Aid appeal: money received (national)
hrp_funding_year_usd.plain: US dollars received for the UN-led humanitarian appeal (response plan) for South Sudan in the year.
hrp_funding_year_usd.method: OCHA FTS: Humanitarian Response Plan funding, calendar year.
hrp_funding_year_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

hrp_requirement_year_usd.label: Aid appeal: money requested (national)
hrp_requirement_year_usd.plain: US dollars the UN-led humanitarian appeal (response plan) asked for to cover needs in South Sudan in the year.
hrp_requirement_year_usd.method: OCHA FTS: Humanitarian Response Plan requirements, calendar year.
hrp_requirement_year_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county. A bigger request reflects bigger needs, not better aid.

state_dept_disbursed_month_usd.label: US State Department aid paid out (national)
state_dept_disbursed_month_usd.plain: US dollars of aid paid out (disbursed) for South Sudan by the US State Department in the month.
state_dept_disbursed_month_usd.method: ForeignAssistance.gov complete transaction file for South Sudan, by transaction month.
state_dept_disbursed_month_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

us_aid_disbursed_month_usd.label: US foreign aid paid out (national)
us_aid_disbursed_month_usd.plain: US dollars of US government foreign aid paid out (disbursed) for South Sudan in the month, all agencies.
us_aid_disbursed_month_usd.method: ForeignAssistance.gov complete transaction file for South Sudan, by transaction month.
us_aid_disbursed_month_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

us_aid_obligated_month_usd.label: US foreign aid committed (national)
us_aid_obligated_month_usd.plain: US dollars of US government foreign aid formally committed (obligated) for South Sudan in the month, all agencies.
us_aid_obligated_month_usd.method: ForeignAssistance.gov complete transaction file for South Sudan, by transaction month.
us_aid_obligated_month_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

usaid_disbursed_month_usd.label: USAID aid paid out (national)
usaid_disbursed_month_usd.plain: US dollars of aid paid out (disbursed) by USAID for South Sudan in the month.
usaid_disbursed_month_usd.method: ForeignAssistance.gov complete transaction file for South Sudan, by transaction month.
usaid_disbursed_month_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

usaid_obligated_month_usd.label: USAID aid committed (national)
usaid_obligated_month_usd.plain: US dollars of aid formally committed (obligated) by USAID for South Sudan in the month.
usaid_obligated_month_usd.method: ForeignAssistance.gov complete transaction file for South Sudan, by transaction month.
usaid_obligated_month_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

acled_civ_events.label: Attacks on civilians (events)
acled_civ_events.plain: Number of recorded violent attacks deliberately targeting civilians in the county that month.
acled_civ_events.method: ACLED public aggregate via HDX, admin-2 monthly. Abyei taken from the Sudan file. ACLED 'violence against civilians' events.
acled_civ_events.caution: Counts only events reported in media and local sources; zero = none recorded. Monthly counts are sparse, so look at 12-month totals.

acled_civ_fatalities.label: Civilians killed in attacks
acled_civ_fatalities.plain: Number of people reported killed in violent attacks targeting civilians in the county that month.
acled_civ_fatalities.method: ACLED public aggregate via HDX, admin-2 monthly. Abyei taken from the Sudan file. Fatalities from 'violence against civilians' events.
acled_civ_fatalities.caution: Counts only events reported in media and local sources; zero = none recorded. Monthly counts are sparse, so look at 12-month totals.

acled_demonstrations.label: Protests and riots
acled_demonstrations.plain: Number of recorded protests and riots in the county that month.
acled_demonstrations.method: ACLED public aggregate via HDX, admin-2 monthly. Abyei taken from the Sudan file. Demonstrations = protests + riots.
acled_demonstrations.caution: Counts only events reported in media and local sources; zero = none recorded. Monthly counts are sparse, so look at 12-month totals.

intracounty_communal_deaths.label: Deaths in inter-communal violence
intracounty_communal_deaths.plain: People killed in violence between communities (for example Dinka, Nuer, Murle or Toposa groups), including cattle-raid clashes, in the county that month.
intracounty_communal_deaths.method: UCDP GED v26.1 non-state and one-sided events whose perpetrators are communal groups or South Sudanese local militias; government and foreign actors excluded. Communal perpetrators only.
intracounty_communal_deaths.caution: UCDP's threshold (25 deaths a year per pair of groups) means cattle raiding and small clashes are under-counted.

intracounty_communal_events.label: Inter-communal violence (events)
intracounty_communal_events.plain: Number of deadly clashes or attacks between communities (for example Dinka, Nuer, Murle or Toposa groups), including cattle raids, in the county that month.
intracounty_communal_events.method: UCDP GED v26.1 non-state and one-sided events whose perpetrators are communal groups or South Sudanese local militias; government and foreign actors excluded. Communal perpetrators only.
intracounty_communal_events.caution: UCDP's threshold (25 deaths a year per pair of groups) means cattle raiding and small clashes are under-counted.

intracounty_conflict_deaths.label: Deaths in local conflict (communities and militias)
intracounty_conflict_deaths.plain: People killed in local violence by community groups or local militias in the county that month.
intracounty_conflict_deaths.method: UCDP GED v26.1 non-state and one-sided events whose perpetrators are communal groups or South Sudanese local militias; government and foreign actors excluded.
intracounty_conflict_deaths.caution: UCDP's threshold (25 deaths a year per pair of groups) means cattle raiding and small clashes are under-counted.

intracounty_conflict_events.label: Local conflict events (communities and militias)
intracounty_conflict_events.plain: Number of deadly events of local violence by community groups or local militias in the county that month.
intracounty_conflict_events.method: UCDP GED v26.1 non-state and one-sided events whose perpetrators are communal groups or South Sudanese local militias; government and foreign actors excluded.
intracounty_conflict_events.caution: UCDP's threshold (25 deaths a year per pair of groups) means cattle raiding and small clashes are under-counted.

acled_pv_events.label: Political violence (events)
acled_pv_events.plain: Number of recorded violent events in the county that month: battles, attacks on civilians, bombings and similar. The main conflict layer.
acled_pv_events.method: ACLED public aggregate via HDX, admin-2 monthly. Abyei taken from the Sudan file. ACLED political-violence category (mainly battles, violence against civilians, explosions/remote violence).
acled_pv_events.caution: Counts only events reported in media and local sources; zero = none recorded. Monthly counts are sparse, so look at 12-month totals.

acled_pv_fatalities.label: Deaths from political violence
acled_pv_fatalities.plain: Number of people reported killed in political violence in the county that month.
acled_pv_fatalities.method: ACLED public aggregate via HDX, admin-2 monthly. Abyei taken from the Sudan file. Reported fatalities from political violence events.
acled_pv_fatalities.caution: Death counts are reported estimates and often uncertain. Zero = none recorded; look at 12-month totals.

ucdp_civilian_deaths.label: Civilians killed (UCDP)
ucdp_civilian_deaths.plain: Number of civilians reported killed in organised violence in the county that month, from the Uppsala Conflict Data Program.
ucdp_civilian_deaths.method: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset v26.1; events with at least one death in conflicts meeting UCDP thresholds.
ucdp_civilian_deaths.caution: Only events with deaths are counted; events located only to state level are left out. Very sparse after 2021.

ucdp_deaths_best.label: Conflict deaths (UCDP)
ucdp_deaths_best.plain: Best estimate of people killed in organised violence in the county that month, from the Uppsala Conflict Data Program.
ucdp_deaths_best.method: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset v26.1; events with at least one death in conflicts meeting UCDP thresholds. Best estimate of deaths.
ucdp_deaths_best.caution: Only events with deaths are counted; events located only to state level are left out. Very sparse after 2021.

ucdp_events.label: Deadly conflict events (UCDP)
ucdp_events.plain: Number of violent events that killed at least one person in the county that month, from the Uppsala Conflict Data Program.
ucdp_events.method: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset v26.1; events with at least one death in conflicts meeting UCDP thresholds.
ucdp_events.caution: Only events with deaths are counted; events located only to state level are left out. Very sparse after 2021.

ucdp_non_state_deaths.label: Deaths in fighting between armed groups (UCDP)
ucdp_non_state_deaths.plain: People killed in fighting between armed groups where no government is involved, such as clashes between communities or militias.
ucdp_non_state_deaths.method: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset v26.1; events with at least one death in conflicts meeting UCDP thresholds. Non-state conflict.
ucdp_non_state_deaths.caution: Only events with deaths are counted; events located only to state level are left out. Very sparse after 2021.

ucdp_non_state_events.label: Fighting between armed groups (UCDP events)
ucdp_non_state_events.plain: Number of deadly events between armed groups where no government is involved, such as clashes between communities or militias.
ucdp_non_state_events.method: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset v26.1; events with at least one death in conflicts meeting UCDP thresholds. Non-state conflict.
ucdp_non_state_events.caution: Only events with deaths are counted; events located only to state level are left out. Very sparse after 2021.

ucdp_one_sided_deaths.label: Civilians killed by armed groups or forces (UCDP)
ucdp_one_sided_deaths.plain: People killed in deliberate attacks on unarmed civilians by a government or an organised armed group.
ucdp_one_sided_deaths.method: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset v26.1; events with at least one death in conflicts meeting UCDP thresholds. One-sided violence.
ucdp_one_sided_deaths.caution: Only events with deaths are counted; events located only to state level are left out. Very sparse after 2021.

ucdp_one_sided_events.label: Deadly attacks on civilians (UCDP events)
ucdp_one_sided_events.plain: Number of deliberate deadly attacks on unarmed civilians by a government or an organised armed group.
ucdp_one_sided_events.method: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset v26.1; events with at least one death in conflicts meeting UCDP thresholds. One-sided violence.

fmr_within_county_total.caution: Counts only people passing IOM monitoring points (mostly Renk from 2023), so totals depend on where points are. Blank Nov 2023-Dec 2024.

edu_girls_share.label: Girls' share of pupils (2015)
edu_girls_share.plain: Share of enrolled pupils who were girls in the 2015 school census. 0.5 would mean equal numbers of girls and boys.
edu_girls_share.method: SSSAMS 2015 school census, girls / all enrolled pupils.
edu_girls_share.caution: From the 2015 school census, the latest open school data; treated as a fixed baseline.

edu_enrolment.label: Pupils enrolled in school (2015)
edu_enrolment.plain: Number of pupils enrolled in schools in the county in the 2015 school census.
edu_enrolment.method: SSSAMS 2015 school census; only schools that reported enrolment (~3,300 of ~4,900).
edu_enrolment.caution: From the 2015 school census, the latest open school data; treated as a fixed baseline. Undercounts: a third of schools did not report.

schools_count.label: Schools (2015)
schools_count.plain: Number of open schools in the county in the 2015 school census.
schools_count.caution: From the 2015 school census, the latest open school data; treated as a fixed baseline.

schools_per100k.label: Schools per 100,000 people
schools_per100k.plain: Number of schools (2015 census) for every 100,000 people living in the county.
schools_per100k.caution: From the 2015 school census, the latest open school data; treated as a fixed baseline.

ethnic_excluded_share.label: Area settled by politically excluded groups
ethnic_excluded_share.plain: Share of the county's area settled by ethnic groups that have no or little power in national government, according to the EPR dataset.
ethnic_excluded_share.method: GeoEPR 2021 + EPR 2021 (ETH Zurich), area overlap of group settlement polygons with the county. Excluded = powerless or discriminated in EPR.
ethnic_excluded_share.how_to_read: 0 to 1: 1 = whole county settled by excluded groups
ethnic_excluded_share.caution: Covers only 10 politically relevant groups; many smaller groups are missing, so some counties show none. Static (2011-2021).

ethnic_dominant_share.label: Area share of the largest ethnic group
ethnic_dominant_share.plain: Share of the county's area settled by its most widespread politically relevant ethnic group. Near 1 = one group dominates.
ethnic_dominant_share.method: GeoEPR 2021 + EPR 2021 (ETH Zurich), area overlap of group settlement polygons with the county.
ethnic_dominant_share.how_to_read: 0 to 1: 1 = one group covers the whole county
ethnic_dominant_share.caution: Covers only 10 politically relevant groups; many smaller groups are missing, so some counties show none. Static (2011-2021).

ethnic_groups_count.label: Number of ethnic groups present
ethnic_groups_count.plain: Number of politically relevant ethnic groups whose settlement areas overlap the county.
ethnic_groups_count.method: GeoEPR 2021 + EPR 2021 (ETH Zurich), area overlap of group settlement polygons with the county.
ethnic_groups_count.caution: Covers only 10 politically relevant groups; many smaller groups are missing, so some counties show none. Static (2011-2021).

gam_prevalence_pct.label: Child acute malnutrition rate (2025)
gam_prevalence_pct.plain: Share of children aged 6-59 months who are acutely malnourished (wasted), from the 2025 IPC analysis.
gam_prevalence_pct.method: IPC acute malnutrition analysis, weight-for-height based GAM.
gam_prevalence_pct.caution: One snapshot (2025). Counties measured another way (arm circumference) are blank.

ipc_amn_phase.label: Child malnutrition severity phase (2025)
ipc_amn_phase.plain: IPC rating of how severe acute malnutrition is in the county, from 1 (acceptable) to 5 (extremely critical).
ipc_amn_phase.method: IPC Acute Malnutrition classification, Jul-Sep 2025 (only county period available).

ipc_phase_class.label: Food insecurity phase (IPC, 1-5)
ipc_phase_class.plain: The county's overall hunger rating on the international IPC scale, from 1 (minimal) to 5 (famine).
ipc_phase_class.method: IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) via HDX; county = sum of analysis areas; placed at first month of each analysis. 2018-2020 published phase; 2022+ derived with the IPC 20% rule.
ipc_phase_class.caution: Phases after 2022 are derived by the team from population figures (match published phases 92% of the time). No 2021 analysis.

ipc_phase3plus_pop.label: People facing crisis-level hunger or worse
ipc_phase3plus_pop.plain: Number of people in IPC Phase 3 or above (crisis, emergency or famine), who cannot meet basic food needs without help.
ipc_phase3plus_pop.method: IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) via HDX; county = sum of analysis areas; placed at first month of each analysis.
ipc_phase3plus_pop.caution: Only 11 analyses (none in 2021); values hold between analyses. Compare analyses, not months.

ipc_phase4plus_pop.label: People facing emergency-level hunger or worse
ipc_phase4plus_pop.plain: Number of people in IPC Phase 4 or above (emergency or famine), facing very large food gaps or high malnutrition and death risk.
ipc_phase4plus_pop.method: IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) via HDX; county = sum of analysis areas; placed at first month of each analysis.
ipc_phase4plus_pop.caution: Only 11 analyses (none in 2021); values hold between analyses. Compare analyses, not months.

ipc_phase3plus_pct.label: Share of people facing crisis-level hunger
ipc_phase3plus_pct.plain: Percentage of the county's population in IPC Phase 3 or above (crisis, emergency or famine). The main food-insecurity layer.
ipc_phase3plus_pct.method: IPC (Integrated Food Security Phase Classification) via HDX; county = sum of analysis areas; placed at first month of each analysis. Phase 3+ population / population analysed.
ipc_phase3plus_pct.caution: Only 11 analyses (none in 2021); values hold between analyses. Compare analyses, not months.

isna_unsafe_water_collect_pct.label: Households feeling unsafe fetching water
isna_unsafe_water_collect_pct.plain: Share of households where someone felt unsafe while collecting water. Women and girls do most water collection, so this signals risk of violence against them.
isna_unsafe_water_collect_pct.method: South Sudan Inter-Sector Needs Assessment (ISNA, REACH/IMPACT for OCHA), household survey Jul-Sep, county tables 2022-2024. Two-week recall in 2023-24.
isna_unsafe_water_collect_pct.caution: Measures risk, not actual incidents. Only 2022, 2023 and 2024; question wording changed between rounds.

isna_wg_avoid_latrines_pct.label: Women and girls avoiding latrines (unsafe)
isna_wg_avoid_latrines_pct.plain: Share of households saying women and girls avoid latrines or bathing areas because they feel unsafe there.
isna_wg_avoid_latrines_pct.method: South Sudan Inter-Sector Needs Assessment (ISNA, REACH/IMPACT for OCHA), household survey Jul-Sep, county tables 2022-2024.
isna_wg_avoid_latrines_pct.caution: Measures risk, not actual incidents. Only 2022, 2023 and 2024; question wording changed between rounds.

isna_wg_avoid_any_pct.label: Women and girls avoiding unsafe places
isna_wg_avoid_any_pct.plain: Share of households saying women and girls avoid at least one place in their area because they feel unsafe there.
isna_wg_avoid_any_pct.method: South Sudan Inter-Sector Needs Assessment (ISNA, REACH/IMPACT for OCHA), household survey Jul-Sep, county tables 2022-2024. 100 minus % reporting no area avoided.
isna_wg_avoid_any_pct.caution: Measures risk, not actual incidents. Only 2022, 2023 and 2024; question wording changed between rounds.

isna_wg_avoid_water_points_pct.label: Women and girls avoiding water points (unsafe)
isna_wg_avoid_water_points_pct.plain: Share of households saying women and girls avoid water points because they feel unsafe there. Used by aid agencies as a gender-violence risk signal.
isna_wg_avoid_water_points_pct.method: South Sudan Inter-Sector Needs Assessment (ISNA, REACH/IMPACT for OCHA), household survey Jul-Sep, county tables 2022-2024.
isna_wg_avoid_water_points_pct.caution: Measures risk, not actual incidents (incident data are confidential). Only 2022, 2023 and 2024; question wording changed between rounds.

health_facilities.label: Health facilities
health_facilities.plain: Number of listed health facilities (hospitals, health centres and health units) in the county.
health_facilities.method: WHO / Ministry of Health Master Facility List, April 2025.
health_facilities.caution: A 2025 list; does not say whether facilities are working.

health_facilities_per100k.label: Health facilities per 100,000 people
health_facilities_per100k.plain: Number of listed health facilities for every 100,000 people living in the county.
health_facilities_per100k.method: WHO / MoH Master Facility List (Apr 2025) / WorldPop 2025 population x 100,000.
health_facilities_per100k.caution: Does not say whether facilities are working.

hospitals.label: Hospitals
hospitals.plain: Number of listed hospitals in the county.
hospitals.method: WHO / MoH Master Facility List (Apr 2025), facilities with 'hospital' in the name.
hospitals.caution: A 2025 list; does not say whether hospitals are working.

hospitals_per100k.label: Hospitals per 100,000 people
hospitals_per100k.plain: Number of listed hospitals for every 100,000 people living in the county.
hospitals_per100k.method: Hospitals from WHO / MoH Master Facility List / WorldPop 2025 population x 100,000.

logcluster_hubs_in_county.label: Aid logistics hubs and warehouses
logcluster_hubs_in_county.plain: Number of humanitarian logistics hubs and shared storage sites (run by or with the UN Logistics Cluster) in the county that month.
logcluster_hubs_in_county.method: WFP Logistics Cluster concept-of-operations maps (dated maps 2018-2026), counted per county.
logcluster_hubs_in_county.caution: No maps Oct 2023-Jan 2026: sites are carried forward through that gap.

hno_severity.label: Severity of humanitarian needs (1-5)
hno_severity.plain: UN's overall rating of how severe people's needs are in the county, combining food, health, water, protection and other sectors.
hno_severity.method: OCHA Humanitarian Needs Overview intersectoral severity, HNO 2022-2024.

hno_pin.label: People in need of aid (UN estimate)
hno_pin.plain: UN estimate of how many people in the county need humanitarian assistance in the year, across all sectors.
hno_pin.method: OCHA Humanitarian Needs Overview intersectoral people-in-need, shown at July of the plan year.
hno_pin.caution: No 2018 or 2020. Method changed between years, so compare years with care.

ops_orgs.label: Aid organisations working in county
ops_orgs.plain: Number of humanitarian organisations reporting activities in the county that month.
ops_orgs.method: OCHA South Sudan 3W operational presence, monthly 2019-2025.
ops_orgs.caution: Reporting coverage grew over time, so part of any rise is better reporting. No 2018; Dec 2020 missing.

ops_orgs_national_ngo.label: South Sudanese NGOs working in county
ops_orgs_national_ngo.plain: Number of national (South Sudanese) non-governmental organisations reporting humanitarian activities in the county that month.
ops_orgs_national_ngo.method: OCHA 3W operational presence, organisation type National NGO.
ops_orgs_national_ngo.caution: Reporting coverage grew over time, so part of any rise is better reporting.

ii_aid_worker_incidents.label: Aid workers killed, hurt, kidnapped or arrested (national)
ii_aid_worker_incidents.plain: Number of incidents in South Sudan where aid workers were killed, injured, kidnapped or arrested in the month.
ii_aid_worker_incidents.method: Insecurity Insight Security in Numbers Database (aid worker KIKA), via HDX.
ii_aid_worker_incidents.caution: National total shown on every county: the source hides incident locations, so no county breakdown exists. Based on open-source reports.

ii_education_attacks.label: Attacks on education (national)
ii_education_attacks.plain: Number of reported attacks on schools, students or teachers in South Sudan in the month.
ii_education_attacks.method: Insecurity Insight Education in Danger incident data, via HDX.
ii_education_attacks.caution: National total shown on every county: the source hides incident locations, so no county breakdown exists. Based on open-source reports.

ii_health_attacks.label: Attacks on health care (national)
ii_health_attacks.plain: Number of reported attacks on health facilities, health workers or patients in South Sudan in the month.
ii_health_attacks.method: Insecurity Insight Attacks on Health Care incident data, via HDX.
ii_health_attacks.caution: National total shown on every county: the source hides incident locations, so no county breakdown exists. Based on open-source reports.

ii_sexual_violence_incidents.label: Conflict-related sexual violence (national)
ii_sexual_violence_incidents.plain: Number of reported incidents of sexual violence linked to conflict in South Sudan in the month. Starts in 2020.
ii_sexual_violence_incidents.method: Insecurity Insight CRSV incident data, via HDX.
ii_sexual_violence_incidents.caution: National total shown on every county; heavily under-reported, so counts are a floor. Starts 2020.

cattle_head.label: Cattle (2015 estimate)
cattle_head.plain: Estimated number of cattle in the county in 2015. Cattle are central to livelihoods and linked to raiding and conflict.
cattle_head.method: FAO Gridded Livestock of the World 4 (2015), modelled distribution summed per county.
cattle_head.caution: Modelled 2015 estimate from old census data; seasonal cattle migration is not shown.

cattle_density.label: Cattle per square km (2015 estimate)
cattle_density.plain: Estimated number of cattle per square kilometre in 2015.
cattle_density.method: FAO Gridded Livestock of the World 4 (2015), modelled distribution summed per county. Divided by county area.
cattle_density.caution: Modelled 2015 estimate from old census data; seasonal cattle migration is not shown.

goats_head.label: Goats (2015 estimate)
goats_head.plain: Estimated number of goats in the county in 2015.
goats_head.method: FAO Gridded Livestock of the World 4 (2015), modelled distribution summed per county.
goats_head.caution: Modelled 2015 estimate from old census data; seasonal cattle migration is not shown.

sheep_head.label: Sheep (2015 estimate)
sheep_head.plain: Estimated number of sheep in the county in 2015.
sheep_head.method: FAO Gridded Livestock of the World 4 (2015), modelled distribution summed per county.
sheep_head.caution: Modelled 2015 estimate from old census data; seasonal cattle migration is not shown.

oil_wells_osm.label: Mapped oil wells
oil_wells_osm.plain: Number of oil wells mapped by volunteers on OpenStreetMap in the county.
oil_wells_osm.caution: Only Rubkona and Guit are mapped; zero elsewhere does not mean no wells.

oil_pipeline_km.label: Oil pipelines (km)
oil_pipeline_km.plain: Length of mapped oil pipelines crossing the county, in kilometres.
oil_pipeline_km.method: Global Energy Monitor GOIT operating lines + OpenStreetMap pipelines (Overture Maps); proposed lines excluded.
oil_pipeline_km.caution: Some overlapping lines may be counted twice.

oil_fields_count.label: Oil fields
oil_fields_count.plain: Number of oil fields listed by Global Energy Monitor in the county.
oil_fields_count.caution: Only 5 South Sudan fields are listed; smaller block-level fields are missing.

unmiss_presence.label: UN peacekeepers present (yes/no)
unmiss_presence.plain: Whether the UN peacekeeping mission (UNMISS) had a base or team site in the county during the year.
unmiss_presence.caution: Bases only; patrols outside bases are not counted.

unmiss_deployment_sites_in_county.label: UN peacekeeping sites in county
unmiss_deployment_sites_in_county.plain: Number of UNMISS peacekeeping deployment sites in the county that month.
unmiss_deployment_sites_in_county.method: UN Geospatial map 4456 (UNMISS deployment) Rev. 58-65, plus news reports of closures.

unmiss_troops.label: UN peacekeeping troops (estimate)
unmiss_troops.plain: Approximate number of UN peacekeeping troops based in the county during the year.
unmiss_troops.method: Geo-PKO estimate from unit sizes on UN deployment maps; 2025 uses Oct 2024 values for sites still on the Jan 2025 map.
unmiss_troops.caution: Approximate; UN police are not fully included.

unmiss_budget_fy_usd.label: UNMISS budget (national)
unmiss_budget_fy_usd.plain: Approved yearly budget of the UN peacekeeping mission in South Sudan, in US dollars (UN fiscal year July-June, repeated each month).
unmiss_budget_fy_usd.method: UN peacekeeping budgets (HDX dpo-pkbudget; General Assembly resolutions).
unmiss_budget_fy_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

unmiss_expenditure_fy_usd.label: UNMISS spending (national)
unmiss_expenditure_fy_usd.plain: What the UN peacekeeping mission in South Sudan actually spent in the year, in US dollars (UN fiscal year July-June, repeated each month).
unmiss_expenditure_fy_usd.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county. Ends June 2025.

unmiss_uniformed_personnel.label: UNMISS troops and police (national)
unmiss_uniformed_personnel.plain: Total uniformed personnel (soldiers, police, military experts) serving with the UN mission in South Sudan that month.
unmiss_uniformed_personnel.method: UN DPO uniformed personnel by mission (HDX).
unmiss_uniformed_personnel.caution: National total shown on every county; it does not vary by county.

pop_total.label: Population (WorldPop estimate)
pop_total.plain: Estimated number of people living in the county in the year. Used to turn counts into rates per person.
pop_total.method: WorldPop Global2 R2025A constrained 1 km, UN-adjusted, summed per county; Abyei from the Sudan grid.
pop_total.caution: Modelled estimate; does not track fast displacement well.

population_estimate.label: Population (official OCHA estimate)
population_estimate.plain: Official humanitarian population estimate for the county, used by UN agencies for planning.
population_estimate.method: OCHA common operational dataset, population statistics (COD-PS) South Sudan 2022 v2.

price_beans_ssp.label: Beans price (South Sudanese pounds)
price_beans_ssp.plain: Market price of beans per kg in South Sudanese pounds. Higher = more expensive.
price_beans_ssp.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. Nominal SSP.
price_beans_ssp.caution: In local currency, which lost most of its value (about 250 to over 4,000 SSP per dollar, 2018-2025). Use the US-dollar version to compare over time.

price_beans_usd.label: Beans price (US$)
price_beans_usd.plain: Market price of beans per kg, converted to US dollars by WFP. Higher = more expensive for households.
price_beans_usd.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. WFP US-dollar price.
price_beans_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

price_cooking_oil_ssp.label: Cooking oil price (South Sudanese pounds)
price_cooking_oil_ssp.plain: Market price of cooking oil per litre in South Sudanese pounds. Higher = more expensive.
price_cooking_oil_ssp.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. Nominal SSP.
price_cooking_oil_ssp.caution: In local currency, which lost most of its value (about 250 to over 4,000 SSP per dollar, 2018-2025). Use the US-dollar version to compare over time.

price_cooking_oil_usd.label: Cooking oil price (US$)
price_cooking_oil_usd.plain: Market price of cooking oil per litre, converted to US dollars by WFP. Higher = more expensive for households.
price_cooking_oil_usd.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. WFP US-dollar price.
price_cooking_oil_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

wage_casual_labour_ssp.label: Daily wage for casual labour (South Sudanese pounds)
wage_casual_labour_ssp.plain: What an unskilled casual (non-farm) labourer earns per day, in South Sudanese pounds.
wage_casual_labour_ssp.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. Nominal SSP.
wage_casual_labour_ssp.caution: In local currency, which lost most of its value (about 250 to over 4,000 SSP per dollar, 2018-2025). Use the US-dollar version to compare over time.

wage_casual_labour_usd.label: Daily wage for casual labour (US$)
wage_casual_labour_usd.plain: What an unskilled casual (non-farm) labourer earns per day, in US dollars. Compared with food prices, it shows how much food a day's work buys.
wage_casual_labour_usd.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. WFP US-dollar value.
wage_casual_labour_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

price_diesel_parallel_ssp.label: Diesel (black-market) price (South Sudanese pounds)
price_diesel_parallel_ssp.plain: Market price of diesel (black-market) per litre in South Sudanese pounds. Higher = more expensive.

price_diesel_parallel_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

price_diesel_ssp.label: Diesel price (South Sudanese pounds)
price_diesel_ssp.plain: Market price of diesel per litre in South Sudanese pounds. Higher = more expensive.
price_diesel_ssp.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. Nominal SSP.
price_diesel_ssp.caution: In local currency, which lost most of its value (about 250 to over 4,000 SSP per dollar, 2018-2025). Use the US-dollar version to compare over time.

price_diesel_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

fx_ssp_per_usd.label: Black-market exchange rate (pounds per US$)
fx_ssp_per_usd.plain: How many South Sudanese pounds one US dollar buys on the unofficial market. Higher = weaker pound and rising import prices.
fx_ssp_per_usd.method: WFP 'Exchange rate (unofficial)' recorded at each market; median over county markets.
fx_ssp_per_usd.caution: Mostly a national signal; county differences are small. Only counties with WFP markets have values.

price_groundnuts_ssp.label: Groundnuts price (South Sudanese pounds)
price_groundnuts_ssp.plain: Market price of groundnuts per kg in South Sudanese pounds. Higher = more expensive.

price_groundnuts_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

price_maize_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

price_petrol_ssp.plain: Market price of petrol per litre in South Sudanese pounds. Higher = more expensive.
price_petrol_ssp.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. Nominal SSP.

price_sorghum_local_ssp.plain: Market price of local sorghum per kg in South Sudanese pounds. Higher = more expensive.

price_sorghum_local_ssp.caution: In local currency, which lost most of its value (about 250 to over 4,000 SSP per dollar, 2018-2025). Use the US-dollar version to compare over time.
