price_sorghum_local_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

price_sorghum_ssp.label: Imported white sorghum price (South Sudanese pounds)
price_sorghum_ssp.plain: Market price of imported white sorghum per kg in South Sudanese pounds. Higher = more expensive.
price_sorghum_ssp.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. Nominal SSP.
price_sorghum_ssp.caution: In local currency, which lost most of its value (about 250 to over 4,000 SSP per dollar, 2018-2025). Use the US-dollar version to compare over time.

price_sorghum_usd.label: Imported white sorghum price (US$)
price_sorghum_usd.plain: Market price of imported white sorghum per kg, converted to US dollars by WFP. Higher = more expensive for households.
price_sorghum_usd.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. WFP US-dollar price.
price_sorghum_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

price_wheat_flour_ssp.label: Wheat flour price (South Sudanese pounds)
price_wheat_flour_ssp.plain: Market price of wheat flour per kg in South Sudanese pounds. Higher = more expensive.
price_wheat_flour_ssp.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. Nominal SSP.
price_wheat_flour_ssp.caution: In local currency, which lost most of its value (about 250 to over 4,000 SSP per dollar, 2018-2025). Use the US-dollar version to compare over time.

price_wheat_flour_usd.label: Wheat flour price (US$)
price_wheat_flour_usd.plain: Market price of wheat flour per kg, converted to US dollars by WFP. Higher = more expensive for households.
price_wheat_flour_usd.method: WFP market monitoring (VAM) via HDX; median over the county's monitored markets. WFP US-dollar price.
price_wheat_flour_usd.caution: Only counties with WFP-monitored markets have values.

imr_national.label: Infant deaths per 1,000 births (national)
imr_national.plain: Number of babies who die before their first birthday for every 1,000 born alive in South Sudan.
imr_national.method: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation via UNICEF.
imr_national.caution: National only. Modelled, with very wide uncertainty.

vacc_mcv1_cov.label: Measles vaccination coverage (2018)
vacc_mcv1_cov.plain: Share of children recorded as getting their first measles vaccine dose in 2018.
vacc_mcv1_cov.caution: 2018 only. Population estimates are poor, so values over 100% are common and near-zero often means no report.

vacc_penta3_cov.label: Childhood vaccine coverage, 3 doses (2018)
vacc_penta3_cov.plain: Share of children recorded as getting all three doses of the pentavalent (DTP3) vaccine in 2018.
vacc_penta3_cov.method: WHO/UNICEF administrative data, 2018; HepB3 dose of pentavalent used as DTP3 proxy.
vacc_penta3_cov.caution: 2018 only. Population estimates are poor, so values over 100% are common and near-zero often means no report.

u5mr_national.label: Child deaths under age 5 per 1,000 births (national)
u5mr_national.plain: Number of children who die before age five for every 1,000 born alive in South Sudan.
u5mr_national.method: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation via UNICEF.
u5mr_national.caution: National only. Modelled, with very wide uncertainty; no survey since 2010.

isna_open_defecation_pct.label: Households with no toilet (open defecation)
isna_open_defecation_pct.plain: Share of households that have no toilet or latrine and relieve themselves in the open. Combined with floods, this contaminates water.
isna_open_defecation_pct.method: South Sudan Inter-Sector Needs Assessment (ISNA, REACH/IMPACT for OCHA), household survey Jul-Sep, county tables 2022-2024.
isna_open_defecation_pct.caution: Only 2022, 2023 and 2024; question wording changed between rounds.

isna_water_30min_plus_pct.label: Households 30+ minutes from drinking water
isna_water_30min_plus_pct.plain: Share of households whose round trip to fetch drinking water takes 30 minutes or more.
isna_water_30min_plus_pct.method: South Sudan Inter-Sector Needs Assessment (ISNA, REACH/IMPACT for OCHA), household survey Jul-Sep, county tables 2022-2024. Sphere 30-minute standard.
isna_water_30min_plus_pct.caution: Only 2022, 2023 and 2024; question wording changed between rounds.

isna_surface_water_source_pct.label: Households drinking untreated surface water
isna_surface_water_source_pct.plain: Share of households whose main drinking water comes from rivers, swamps, ponds or unprotected wells, which carries a risk of cholera.
isna_surface_water_source_pct.method: South Sudan Inter-Sector Needs Assessment (ISNA, REACH/IMPACT for OCHA), household survey Jul-Sep, county tables 2022-2024.
isna_surface_water_source_pct.caution: Only 2022, 2023 and 2024; question wording changed between rounds.

wps_ipv_pct.label: Women facing partner violence (national)
wps_ipv_pct.plain: Share of women who experienced violence from an intimate partner, from the Women, Peace and Security Index.
wps_ipv_pct.method: Georgetown GIWPS Women, Peace and Security Index, editions 2017/18-2025/26.
wps_ipv_pct.caution: National value shown on every county. Only every two years; methods differ between editions.

wps_rank.label: Women, Peace & Security rank (national)
wps_rank.plain: South Sudan's world rank on the Women, Peace and Security Index. 1 = best in the world, so a larger number is worse.
wps_rank.method: Georgetown GIWPS Women, Peace and Security Index, editions 2017/18-2025/26.
wps_rank.how_to_read: 1 = best country; higher rank number = worse
wps_rank.caution: National value shown on every county. Only every two years; methods differ between editions.

wps_index.label: Women, Peace & Security score (national)
wps_index.plain: South Sudan's overall score on women's inclusion, justice and security, from 0 (worst) to 1 (best).
wps_index.method: Georgetown GIWPS Women, Peace and Security Index, editions 2017/18-2025/26.
wps_index.caution: National value shown on every county. Only every two years; methods differ between editions. No score for 2017/18.

wps_community_safety_pct.label: Women feeling safe in their community (national)
wps_community_safety_pct.plain: Share of women who say they feel safe walking alone at night in their community.
wps_community_safety_pct.method: Georgetown GIWPS Women, Peace and Security Index, editions 2017/18-2025/26.
wps_community_safety_pct.caution: National value shown on every county. Only every two years; methods differ between editions.

wps_parliament_women_pct.label: Women in parliament (national)
wps_parliament_women_pct.plain: Share of seats in the national parliament held by women.
wps_parliament_women_pct.method: Georgetown GIWPS Women, Peace and Security Index, editions 2017/18-2025/26.
wps_parliament_women_pct.caution: National value shown on every county. Only every two years; methods differ between editions.

wps_cellphone_pct.label: Women using a mobile phone (national)
wps_cellphone_pct.plain: Share of women who use a mobile phone.
wps_cellphone_pct.method: Georgetown GIWPS Women, Peace and Security Index, editions 2017/18-2025/26.
wps_cellphone_pct.caution: National value shown on every county. Only every two years; methods differ between editions.

wps_employment_pct.label: Women in paid work (national)
wps_employment_pct.plain: Share of women who are employed.
wps_employment_pct.method: Georgetown GIWPS Women, Peace and Security Index, editions 2017/18-2025/26.
wps_employment_pct.caution: National value shown on every county. Only every two years; methods differ between editions.

wps_financial_inclusion_pct.label: Women with a bank or mobile-money account (national)
wps_financial_inclusion_pct.plain: Share of women who have an account at a bank or other financial institution, or a mobile-money account.
wps_financial_inclusion_pct.method: Georgetown GIWPS Women, Peace and Security Index, editions 2017/18-2025/26.
wps_financial_inclusion_pct.caution: National value shown on every county. Only every two years; methods differ between editions.

wps_education_years.label: Women's years of schooling (national)
wps_education_years.plain: Average number of years women aged 25 and over have spent in school.
wps_education_years.method: Georgetown GIWPS Women, Peace and Security Index, editions 2017/18-2025/26.
wps_education_years.caution: National value shown on every county. Only every two years; methods differ between editions.

sudd_floodedveg_km2.label: Flooded vegetation, Sudd (km²)
sudd_floodedveg_km2.plain: Area of swamp and grassland standing in water (papyrus, reeds, flooded grass) in Sudd counties. Radar and plain water maps often miss this kind of flooding.
sudd_floodedveg_km2.method: MODIS 8-day inundation (incl. flooded vegetation, Xiao/Sakamoto rule) minus open water (MNDWI > 0); cloudy pixels gap-filled.

sudd_floodedveg_pct.label: Flooded vegetation, Sudd (% of county)
sudd_floodedveg_pct.plain: Share of the county covered by swamp or grassland standing in water. Radar and plain water maps often miss this kind of flooding.
sudd_floodedveg_pct.method: MODIS 8-day inundation (incl. flooded vegetation, Xiao/Sakamoto rule) minus open water (MNDWI > 0); cloudy pixels gap-filled.

protection_partners.label: Protection and GBV aid partners in county
protection_partners.plain: Number of aid organisations reporting protection work (including help for survivors of gender-based violence and child protection) in the county that month.
protection_partners.method: OCHA South Sudan 3W operational presence, Protection sector, monthly 2019-2025 (team compilation).
protection_partners.caution: Counts organisations, not service points. No 2018; Dec 2020 missing. Reporting changes between years, so compare months within a year.

nutrition_partners.label: Nutrition aid partners in county
nutrition_partners.plain: Number of aid organisations reporting nutrition work (such as treating malnourished children) in the county that month.
nutrition_partners.method: OCHA South Sudan 3W operational presence, Nutrition sector, monthly 2019-2025 (team compilation).
nutrition_partners.caution: Counts organisations, not feeding sites. No 2018; Dec 2020 missing. Reporting changes between years, so compare months within a year.
